lead.tldr: Bitcoin rebounds above $65,000 on institutional ETF inflows amid extreme fear sentiment. • Bitwise acquires Chorus One, instantly scaling staking to $2.2 billion in assets. • Hong Kong advances stablecoin licensing next month, signaling regulatory clarity. • SEC enables WisdomTree 24/7 tokenized fund trading, boosting TradFi-blockchain integration. • Better secures $500 million Sky stablecoin credit for mortgage tokenization expansion. • Bitcoin ETFs face sustained outflows, pressuring prices after prior rally support.

top_signals.title: North Carolina prosecutors seize $61 million in USDT tied to 'pig butchering' scam
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of North Carolina announced the seizure of over $61 million in USDT cryptocurrency linked to "pig butchering" investment scams, where criminals establish fake romantic relationships to gain victims' trust before directing them to fraudulent trading platforms. Law enforcement, led by Homeland Security Investigations, traced the funds to multiple cryptocurrency wallet addresses used to launder money stolen from victims who were shown fictitious high-return portfolios and then denied withdrawals or charged fake "taxes" and "fees." This seizure represents a record single recovery in crypto fraud enforcement and demonstrates law enforcement's advancing capability to track illicit cryptocurrency flows in real time through on-chain analysis. The case underscores the broader challenge facing regulators, as the $61 million recovery remains a fraction of the estimated $17 billion in global cryptocurrency fraud losses recorded in 2025.

top_signals.title: Nvidia, Microsoft and SoftBank back self-driving startup Wayve in $1.5bn round
top_signals.summary: Wayve, a self-driving startup, has secured $1.5 billion in funding from Nvidia, Microsoft, and SoftBank. Uber will also invest an additional $300 million to support a global 'robotaxi' rollout.

top_signals.title: Bitwise Acquires $2.2B Crypto Staking Firm Chorus One
top_signals.summary: Bitwise has acquired Chorus One, a crypto staking firm that stakes $2.2 billion in crypto assets. This acquisition significantly boosts Bitwise's crypto staking business.

top_signals.title: Hong Kong to issue first stablecoin issuer licenses next month: finance chief
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong is expected to issue the first licenses for fiat-referenced stablecoin issuers in March, according to Financial Secretary Paul Chan. This marks a significant step in Hong Kong's regulatory approach to stablecoins.

top_signals.title: AI chip startup Axelera AI raises $250m to take on Nvidia
top_signals.summary: Axelera AI, a Dutch startup building chips for AI inference, has raised $250 million to compete with Nvidia in the growing inference market. The funding will help Axelera AI scale its operations and challenge Nvidia's dominance.

top_signals.title: Exclusive: As AI threatens search, Profound raises $96 million to help brands stay visible
top_signals.summary: Profound, an 18-month-old startup, raised $96 million in a Lightspeed-led Series C round, valuing the company at $1 billion. The funding aims to help brands stay visible as AI systems like ChatGPT threaten traditional search methods.

top_signals.title: Better partners with Framework Ventures on $500 million Sky stablecoin credit plan amid mortgage tokenization push
top_signals.summary: Better partners with Framework Ventures on a $500 million credit plan through Sky's stablecoin ecosystem, supporting their mortgage tokenization efforts. The partnership also includes a $45 million equity investment.

top_signals.title: SEC grants WisdomTree exemptive relief for 24/7 trading of regulated tokenized mutual fund
top_signals.summary: The SEC and FINRA have granted WisdomTree exemptive relief to allow 24/7 trading and instant settlement for tokenized shares of the WisdomTree Treasury Money Market Digital Fund. This marks a significant step towards the integration of traditional finance with blockchain technology.

top_signals.title: Better, Framework Ventures Strike $500M Stablecoin Mortgage Deal
top_signals.summary: Better partners with Framework Ventures to secure $500 million in stablecoin financing. This deal connects DeFi liquidity with traditional U.S. mortgage lending, potentially bridging the gap between the two financial systems.

top_signals.title: Blockchain Association Pitches Crypto Tax Plan to Congress
top_signals.summary: The Blockchain Association has proposed a crypto tax framework to Congress, suggesting stablecoins be treated as cash and low-dollar crypto transactions receive a de minimis exemption. This proposal aims to provide clarity and potentially reduce the tax burden on small crypto transactions.

top_signals.title: Stripe Eyes PayPal Acquisition as Stock Hits Multi-Year Low
top_signals.summary: Stripe is reportedly considering acquiring PayPal, a rival payments processor. PayPal has been struggling in the evolving payments market.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs bleed with six weeks of outflows
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin ETFs are experiencing outflows after fueling Bitcoin's rally, potentially contributing to a price decline. The ETFs that previously drove Bitcoin's growth are now exerting downward pressure.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, In the ever-evolving world of innovation, this week brings stark reminders of both challenges and triumphs across crypto and beyond. North Carolina prosecutors just seized over $61 million in USDT linked to "pig butchering" scams, where fraudsters build fake romantic relationships to lure victims into bogus trading platforms promising sky-high returns, only to lock funds with invented fees and taxes. Led by Homeland Security Investigations, this record single recovery highlights law enforcement's growing prowess in real-time on-chain tracking, though it pales against the estimated $17 billion in global crypto fraud losses last year. At Blockwall, we champion regulated, transparent Web3 solutions to combat such risks and build trust in our ecosystem. Shifting to breakthroughs, self-driving startup Wayve raised $1.5 billion from heavyweights like Nvidia, Microsoft, and SoftBank, with Uber adding $300 million for a global robotaxi rollout. This massive round signals converging tech frontiers, where AI and mobility intersect, much like our investments blending blockchain with real-world applications in supply chains and IoT. In crypto-native moves, Bitwise acquired Chorus One, the firm staking $2.2 billion in assets, supercharging its staking operations. Consolidations like this underscore maturing infrastructure, aligning perfectly with Blockwall's thesis-driven bets on pre-seed and seed Web3 founders tackling treasury management, decentralized identity, and node infrastructure. As Europe leads with MiCA fostering innovation and protection, these stories fuel our conviction in a secure digital future.
